summary: OpenAI and Molecule.one describe a near-autonomous AI chemist using GPT-5.4 that improved a specific drug-making reaction in medicinal chemistry research.

practices.reason: The case study is a lab-and-partner demonstration of model performance on a specific chemistry task, informative but not a transferable eval an engineering team could run.
practices.quote: OpenAI and Molecule.one show how a near-autonomous AI chemist using GPT-5.4 improved a key drug-making reaction, advancing medicinal chemistry research.
